title: ID0444657-DC/Si-D/BE-[MULTIPLE] Error during charging sessions
description:
Reported behavior/issue:  Error during charging sessions
Solution:
For the Payment Terminal error, this is because of the hotfix we've created in order to keep the CCV working. When we receive the Terminal communication timeout message, we restart the service and that's why you see that error in the backend.
Just <1 min later the error is false when the service is back online.
For the Router1 loss, it was a one-time occurence since 4 weeks ago. It might've been a sudden communication drop.

additional_info.body:
Dear Francisco
Please ignore my last email, I just found out that the terminal is broken.
The charger was still under warranty when the case was made. Is it possible to schedule an intervention to replace the terminal please?
Ticket was made on 23/07/2025 and the warranty ended on 15/08/2025.
Here you can find the conclusion of our tech that went on site:
On the MA-197-02, CCV still did not work after rebooting. The charger cannot connect to the terminal (“no terminal connected”).I was also unable to connect to the terminal using the TS3 software. The terminal produces a pulsating beep (as we also had in Aalst with the defective terminal there).
